verbalization: Eclalbasaponin III is implicated in the regulation of Macrophage-expressed gene 1 protein through a multi-step pathway involving Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. This transporter, which is a target of both Cochliomycin A and 3'-Methoxyglabridin, appears to be a critical mediator in the interaction between Eclalbasaponin III and the macrophage gene. The evidence suggests that Eclalbasaponin III may modulate the activity of this transporter, which in turn influences the expression of the target gene. The presence of multiple targets (Cochliomycin A and 3'-Methoxyglabridin) further supports the idea that Eclalbasaponin III acts through a shared mechanism, possibly by enhancing or inhibiting the function of the transporter. The integration of these pathways highlights the potential role of the transporter in mediating the effects of Eclalbasaponin III on macrophage gene expression, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
